review_cases.title: Tropical Cyclone Oma / NASA JSC ISS Expedition 58 time-lapse
review_cases.credit_proposal: Video courtesy of the Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, NASA Johnson Space Center. Tropical Cyclone Oma, ISS Expedition 58. Source: eol.jsc.nasa.gov.
review_questions: Watch full 27.84 s, beginning/middle/end, and examine possible transitions, written overlays and third-party imagery.
Check 1080x720 (3:2) image fits 1920x1080 (16:9) without misleading crop or poor upscaling.
Caption as Tropical Cyclone Oma (South Pacific, 2019); do not call it the Atlantic Hurricane Oma or imply it's the other two storms.
Confirm exact NASA JSC credit, video-page reference, no endorsement or third-party/person rights issues.

review_cases.title: Hurricane Helene eye / NOAA WP-3D Orion Hurricane Hunter camera
review_cases.credit_proposal: Nick Underwood / NOAA OMAO. Eye of Hurricane Helene; NOAA WP-3D Orion, September 25, 2024.
review_questions: Watch all 34.83 s and listen to whole embedded AAC audio; identify any copyrighted music, voice, private conversation or third-party audio.
Check aircraft interiors for visible people, logos, third-party branding, captions or non-NOAA components; record timecodes.
Make clear this is a real in-flight hurricane view, not ocean-surface footage or the same storm as Oma.
Preserve individual Nick Underwood/NOAA credit and check OMAO usage and emblem/no-endorsement terms.

review_cases.title: NOAA Ocean Exploration wind-driven North Atlantic swells (2021 expedition)
review_cases.credit_proposal: Video courtesy of NOAA Ocean Exploration, 2021 North Atlantic Stepping Stones: New England and Corner Rise Seamounts.
review_questions: Watch all 17.48 s and listen to entire AAC track; check for copyrighted music, speech, recognizable crew or visible third-party logos.
Confirm full 1920x1080 image and suitability for a 30fps final cut; source audio is 44.1kHz and excluded pending clearance.
Use footage solely as illustrative wind-driven open-sea surface: NOT a hurricane observation and NOT a water-temperature measurement.
Preserve the exact NOAA Ocean Exploration source-page credit and check page for any individual copyrighted media exception.
